stem_md: 设方程 $F(\frac xz,\frac zy)=0$ 可确定隐函数 $z=z(x,y)$，求 $(z_x,z_y)$。
analysis_md:
由隐函数求导公式得

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{\frac{1}{z}F_1'}{\left(-\frac{x}{z^2}\right)F_1'+\frac{1}{y}F_2'}=\frac{yzF_1'}{xyF_1'-z^2F_2'},\qquad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{-\frac{z}{y^2}F_2'}{\left(-\frac{x}{z^2}\right)F_1'+\frac{1}{y}F_2'}=\frac{z^3F_2'}{y(z^2F_2'-xyF_1')}
$$
search_text:
设方程 $F(\frac xz,\frac zy)=0$ 可确定隐函数 $z=z(x,y)$，求 $(z_x,z_y)$。 $(-\frac{yF_1'}{xyF_1'-z^2F_2'},-\frac{z^2F_1'}{y(z^2F_2'-xyF_1')})$ $(\frac{yF_1'}{xyF_1'-z^2F_2'},-\frac{z^2F_1'}{y(z^2F_2'-xyF_1')})$ $(\frac{yzF_1'}{xyF_1'-z^2F_2'},\frac{z^3F_1'}{y(z^2F_2'-xyF_1')})$ $(\frac{yzF_1'}{xyF_1'-z^2F_2'},-\frac{z^3F_1'}{y(z^2F_2'-xyF_1')})$ 由隐函数求导公式得

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{\frac{1}{z}F_1'}{\left(-\frac{x}{z^2}\right)F_1'+\frac{1}{y}F_2'}=\frac{yzF_1'}{xyF_1'-z^2F_2'},\qquad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{-\frac{z}{y^2}F_2'}{\left(-\frac{x}{z^2}\right)F_1'+\frac{1}{y}F_2'}=\frac{z^3F_2'}{y(z^2F_2'-xyF_1')}
$$
